name: Racing (drive, drift)
pitch: A three-lap race against three rivals on a low-poly island circuit: steer, drift the corners for a boost, cross the line first.
camera: third person, a chase camera behind the vehicle
controls: WASD or arrows to drive, Space to drift (handbrake), R to get back on the road. Gamepad works (stick, triggers).
use_when: car, kart, boat, hover or bike racing, time trials, delivery driving: anything where you steer a vehicle along a route and see it from behind. The track is a list of points, so new circuits are quick.
not_for: open-world driving off the road, realistic car simulation (see the car block), on-foot characters, first-person games
already_good: Arcade handling in plain maths: immediate, speed-sensitive steering that works on a keyboard
Drifts you can hold and catch, that charge a boost and can never spin out
Speed you can see: widening view, speed lines, striped road, skid marks, smoke, engine and wind
Rails that scrape instead of stopping you, and a reset that always faces forward
Rivals with a racing line, overtakes, mistakes and gentle rubber-banding
Tracks as data (two included), checkpoints, lap times and a best-lap ghost hook
